_doc: Values RELAYED to the evidence lane that are NOT verified against held bytes (the source is not openly held). Read by harness/relayed_values.py and shown beside their row; NEVER data: never pooled, never a count, until the source is held and the value is bound. Recorded by the evidence lane (Claude Opus 5.5).

values.outcome: Treatment discontinuation due to adverse events
values.value: 18/111 metformin vs 6/114 placebo (discontinuation due to side effects)
values.said_to_be_in: the BMJ full report and the investigators' later report of the same trial
values.why_not_held: BMJ PDF (www.bmj.com) answered 403; the PMC copy (PMC1482338) answered a bot-check page; Europe PMC: not in the open-access subset; the committed ft_16769748.txt is front matter + abstract only. Recorded in evidence/acquisition_cascade/ATTEMPTS.jsonl (targets Moll2006, Moll-later).

values.value: first MACE 59/484 evolocumab vs 74/484 placebo (Table 4; exploratory, adjudicated; safety population)
values.why_not_held: JAMA full text not open; the Amsterdam UMC repository PDF 403; the Jagiellonian repository unreachable (URLError, twice); the registry posts no MACE; recorded in evidence/acquisition_cascade/ATTEMPTS.jsonl
not_for: a patient composite built by summing Table 4's component rows (a patient with two components would count twice)

values.why_not_held: NEJM PDF 403; the Keele repository copy 403; the Luxembourg repository unreachable; Europe PMC not open access; the FDA ENTRESTO label gives rounded percentages of CODED adverse events (a different definition).
